author: nafepain
body: my name is zombiexpert101, i was banned for click aim-bot on June 6 2014. i am very sorry for what i did after playing mine craft for the past year i realize that hacking is not necessary and unfair. I am doing an appeal an infraction because this is wanna my favorite server. I promise i will follow the rules. Please accept my apology thank you.
